title: TitanDrive head unit (E87, automatic climate)
summary: What an Android head-unit install needs on an automatic-climate E87, and how it all plugs together.
safety: Disconnect the battery before unplugging the radio.
Keep wires clear of the airbag and its yellow connectors.

steps.title: Confirm the car's setup
steps.text: Automatic climate is confirmed. Check the radio type and whether you have parking sensors before choosing the kit.

steps.title: Check the listing
steps.text: Share the exact listing with Titan. Check it supports CarPlay and Android Auto, lets you install your own APKs and launcher, and includes the auto-climate frame and CAN-bus lead.

steps.title: Disconnect the battery
steps.text: Disconnect the negative terminal (it's in the boot on the E87) and wait a few minutes before touching the radio wiring.
steps.warn: Keep clear of the airbag wiring (yellow connectors).

steps.title: Fit and test
steps.text: Remove the old radio, plug in the CAN-bus lead and aerial adaptor, reconnect the battery and test everything before clipping the frame home.

steps.title: Later: live OBD2 dashboard
steps.text: Add an OBD2 adaptor and run your own dashboard APK on the head unit.

disclaimer: Kits differ for automatic vs manual climate and PDC vs non-PDC cars. Check the exact listing before buying.
